controls: invite email identities must be canonical lowercase addresses
invite roles must be admin, editor, or viewer
invite status must be pending, accepted, or revoked
invite creation timestamps must be canonical UTC ISO-8601 milliseconds
only revoked invites may carry a canonical revokedAt at or after creation
a team may not retain duplicate pending invitations for one email
positiveFixtures: canonical revoked invitation is admitted and backed up

verification.secrets: npm run scan:secrets: passed across 208 files

limitations: No email delivery, identity-provider call, authenticated LibTV write, external backup, staging mutation, deployment, signing, or activation was performed.
Authenticated team comparison, independent review, and external reliability evidence remain separately gated.
